definitions.major_failure: A solid human trial that found no benefit, or a trial stopped for futility, lack of effect, safety or its results. Trials stopped for funding or slow recruitment don't count.
definitions.outcomes: Positive, negative, mixed and unclear are what each treatment study's own conclusion says. Unclear includes studies that only reported safety.
definitions.solid_trial: A trial in people that was randomized and controlled (placebo, sham or comparison treatment), past the first safety stage, and not a pilot, open-label or single-group study.

meanings.A: At least one solid human trial showed benefit, with no major failures.
meanings.B: Promising human results from small or early studies, supported by animal or lab work.
meanings.C: Promising results in animals or cells only, or mixed results in people.
meanings.D: Little evidence so far, or human trials that failed or were stopped.
meanings.n/a: Not graded: biomarkers are tests, not treatments.

mechanisms.description: Treatments for symptoms (orthostatic hypotension, bladder, sleep, ataxia, gait) that do not target the underlying disease, including brain and spinal stimulation and rehabilitation.
mechanisms.name: Symptomatic & rehabilitative treatment
mechanisms.reason: Mixed in people: 3 human studies reported benefit, but 6 found no benefit; 1 was mixed; 4 solid trials failed; 2 trials were stopped for futility, safety or poor results.

mechanisms.description: Purkinje cell loss and degeneration of pontine nuclei, middle cerebellar peduncles and inferior olives: the defining pathology of MSA-C.
mechanisms.name: Cerebellar & olivopontocerebellar degeneration
mechanisms.reason: Mixed in people: 1 human study reported benefit, but 1 found no benefit.

mechanisms.description: Iron accumulation and reactive oxygen species promote α-synuclein aggregation and cell death (ferroptosis).
mechanisms.name: Oxidative stress & iron
mechanisms.reason: 7 animal or lab studies reported benefit, but no human study has yet.

mechanisms.description: COQ2 variants and reduced coenzyme Q10 in MSA brain implicate impaired mitochondrial respiration; ubiquinol supplementation is under trial.
mechanisms.name: Mitochondrial dysfunction & CoQ10
mechanisms.reason: 6 animal or lab studies reported benefit, but no human study has yet.

mechanisms.description: Restoring trophic support (GDNF, BDNF) or replacing/supporting cells with mesenchymal stem cells.
mechanisms.name: Neurotrophic & regenerative therapy
mechanisms.reason: 3 animal or lab studies reported benefit, but no human study has yet.

mechanisms.description: Antisense oligonucleotides or RNA interference that reduce SNCA expression.
mechanisms.name: α-Synuclein lowering (ASO / gene silencing)
mechanisms.reason: 1 animal or lab study reported benefit, but no human study has yet.

mechanisms.description: Misfolded α-synuclein forms glial cytoplasmic inclusions (GCIs) in oligodendrocytes and spreads cell-to-cell in a prion-like way. Small molecules aim to block aggregation.
mechanisms.name: α-Synuclein aggregation & spread
mechanisms.reason: Human results so far are negative: 2 human studies found no benefit (2 solid trials); 1 trial was stopped for futility, safety or poor results.

mechanisms.description: MSA is primarily an oligodendrogliopathy: TPPP/p25α relocalisation, myelin loss and failed trophic support of axons precede neuronal loss.
mechanisms.name: Oligodendroglial dysfunction & myelin
mechanisms.reason: Human results so far are negative: 1 human study found no benefit (a solid trial).

mechanisms.description: Microglial and astroglial activation, TLR4 / NLRP3 inflammasome signalling and myeloperoxidase-driven oxidative damage.
mechanisms.name: Neuroinflammation & immune modulation
mechanisms.reason: Human results so far are negative: 1 human study found no benefit (a solid trial).

mechanisms.description: Failure to clear misfolded proteins via autophagy, the lysosome (incl. GBA) or the ubiquitin-proteasome system.
mechanisms.name: Autophagy, lysosome & proteostasis
mechanisms.reason: Human results so far are negative: 1 human study found no benefit (a solid trial); 2 trials were stopped for futility, safety or poor results.

mechanisms.description: Antibodies (passive) or vaccines (active) that bind extracellular α-synuclein to limit spread.
mechanisms.name: α-Synuclein immunotherapy
mechanisms.reason: Human results so far are negative: 1 human study found no benefit (a solid trial).

mechanisms.description: Altered gut microbiota and enteric α-synuclein as potential disease drivers.
mechanisms.name: Gut–brain axis & microbiome
mechanisms.reason: Little evidence so far: no treatment study has reported a benefit.

mechanisms.description: Inherited variants (e.g. COQ2, SNCA, GBA) and genome-wide association findings.
mechanisms.name: Genetic risk factors
mechanisms.reason: Human results so far are negative: 1 human study found no benefit (a solid trial).

mechanisms.description: Tools that make trials possible: α-synuclein seed amplification assays, neurofilament light, skin biopsy, imaging. Not a disease mechanism itself.
mechanisms.name: Biomarkers & early diagnosis
mechanisms.reason: Biomarker studies measure the disease; they don't test treatments.
